chunks: And by this chain, from Hariz, from Al-Fudayl, who said:

I asked Abu Ja'far (peace be upon him) about the words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'Those who preserve their Prayers.' He said: 'It is the Obligatory [prayer].' I said: 'Those who are constant at their Prayer?' He said: 'It is the optional [prayer].'
ai.seo_question: What is the difference between preserving obligatory prayers and being constant in voluntary prayers according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) elucidates the linguistic nuance in the Quranic description of the believers, distinguishing between the strict maintenance of the five daily obligatory prayers (Fard) and the consistent devotion in voluntary prayers (Nafl). This distinction highlights the Shia jurisprudential emphasis on both the foundational duty of Fard and the spiritual elevation achieved through the regularity of Nafl, reflecting the comprehensive nature of worship in Shia tradition.
